mapper.select: SELECT C.CORNER_NAME AS "cornerName" , C.CORNER_CD AS "cornerCd" , B.TERM_GROUP_NAME AS "termGroupName" , C.CORNER_TYPE_CD AS "cornerTypeCd" , CASE C.OPERATION_TYPE_CD WHEN '1' THEN '3' WHEN '2' THEN '2' WHEN '3' THEN '1' ELSE 'Z' END AS "operationTypeCd" , CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRIM(C.SERVICE_START_TIME)) = 4 AND LENGTH(TRIM(C.SERVICE_END_TIME)) = 4 THEN SUBSTR(C.SERVICE_START_TIME, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(C.SERVICE_START_TIME, 3, 2) || '~' || SUBSTR(C.SERVICE_END_TIME, 1, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(C.SERVICE_END_TIME, 3, 2) ELSE ' ' END AS "serviceTime" , C.GUARD_CO_CD AS "guardCoCd" , C.OUTSRC_CO_CD AS "outsrcCoCd" , A.ASSET_SNO AS "assetSno" , A.ATM_CO_CD AS "atmCoCd" , A.MODEL_CD AS "modelCd" , A.PROTOCOL_TYPE AS "protocolType" , D.TERM_GROUP_ID AS "termGroupId" , D.TERM_ID AS "termId" , D.JNL_DATE AS "jnlDate" , D.JNL_TIME AS "jnlTime" , D.AGENT_TYPE AS "agentType" , SUBSTR(D.ATM_STATUS, 2) AS "atmStatus" , D.ERR_CD AS "errCd" , D.ATM_ERR_CD AS "atmErrCd" , D.PROCESS_COUNT AS "processCount" , '0' || D.MAN_STATUS AS "manStatus" , '0' || D.OMAN_STATUS AS "omanStatus" , '0' || D.SPR_STATUS AS "sprStatus" , '0' || D.JPR_STATUS AS "jprStatus" , '0' || D.CHK_STATUS AS "chkStatus" , '0' || D.CHA_STATUS AS "chaStatus" , '0' || D.MCR_STATUS AS "mcrStatus" , '0' || D.PB_STATUS AS "pbStatus" , '0' || D.RJT_STATUS AS "rjtStatus" , A.APP_VERSION AS "appVersion" , E.DES_APPLY AS "desApply" , E.IC_APPLY AS "icApply" , E.EMV_APPLY AS "emvApply" , E.IR_APPLY AS "irApply" , E.RF_APPLY AS "rfApply" , E.FP_APPLY AS "fpApply" , E.OMAN_APPLY AS "omanApply" , E.ENCODE_APPLY AS "encodeApply" FROM T_ATM A LEFT JOIN T_ATM_GROUP B ON A.TERM_GROUP_ID = B.TERM_GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN T_CORNER C ON A.CORNER_CD = C.CORNER_CD AND A.TERM_GROUP_ID = C.TERM_GROUP_ID LEFT JOIN T_ATM_MONITOR D ON A.TERM_GROUP_ID = D.TERM_GROUP_ID AND A.TERM_ID = D.TERM_ID LEFT JOIN T_ATM_DEVICE_STATUS E ON E.TERM_GROUP_ID = A.TERM_GROUP_ID AND E.TERM_ID = A.TERM_ID WHERE A.TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND A.TERM_ID = #{termId} AND D.JNL_DATE = #{jnlDate} AND D.JNL_TIME = #{jnlTime}

SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN DENOM_CD = '10000' THEN SUBSTR(LPAD(TO_CHAR(NVL(REMAIN_COUNT, 0)), 5, '0'), -5) END) AS "manRemain" , MAX(CASE WHEN DENOM_CD = '50000' THEN SUBSTR(LPAD(TO_CHAR(NVL(REMAIN_COUNT, 0)), 5, '0'), -5) END) AS "omanRemain" , MAX(CASE WHEN DENOM_CD = '100000' THEN SUBSTR(LPAD(TO_CHAR(NVL(REMAIN_COUNT, 0)), 5, '0'), -5) END) AS "checkRemain" FROM T_CASSETTE_STATUS WHERE TERM_GROUP_ID = #{termGroupId} AND TERM_ID = #{termId} AND CASSETTE_TYPE IN ('1', '4')
